input.prompt: Use case: original mobile game sprite. Draw Moon Shadow, our chibi Daoist swordswoman, as exactly THREE transparent walking key poses in one horizontal PNG. Equal square cells with clean transparent gutters and no text or floors. Reference 1 is the exact existing character and view; reference 2 is the native action position/order, reference 3 magnifies native legs and arms. Use references 2 and 3 for action anatomy only. References 4 and 5 set the original hand-painted Chinese Daoist Q finish only. Render silver bob hair, navy and gold hairflower, navy scarf, ivory sleeves, navy coat with brushed gold embroidered moon/cloud motifs, dark blue cuffed trousers, gold-striped navy boots and ONE silver crescent blade held firmly in EACH hand, blades distinct and separated. Preserve exact costume, face or back-of-head and camera across all three panels. Short same-scale body, same head and belt height and consistent proportions. This is a compact steady walk. Arms move slightly and each blade follows its own hand. No leaps, high knees, lunges, oversized feet, detached weapons, shadows, captions, panel lines, backdrop, glow or checkerboard. Actual transparent background, 12% horizontal clear gutter around each character, clean silhouette for small mobile size. Camera strictly straight from BEHIND. No eyes, face, nose, chest medallion or front toe caps. Navy bow-flower and scarf trail SCREEN LEFT like ref 1. The two jacket openings and both boot heels are clearly readable. Use BOTTOM row left to right. f9: two navy heel soles end at the same height and look adjacent below the robe. Hands held low. f10: boot heel on the scarf-trailing side, SCREEN LEFT, is the LOWER boot. Screen-right boot heel ends visibly HIGHER, partly receding under its coat hem. f11: scarf-side heel remains clearly LOWER, with empty distance underneath the screen-right boot visible. Lift the SCREEN RIGHT sleeve and the crescent held there by a little. Match the source's alternating short leg shapes; use a vertical difference of roughly 35–55 pixels in a 724 px cell. Far heel is never a sole-up kick.
